system.description:
Deal [[/r 2d6 + @battle-status.power.attack.total]]{[2D + (Attack Power)]} physical damage. This attack triggers [SR+1] stacks of [Pursuit] instead of one.

(Critical): [Pursuit] triggered by this attack are not removed.

A special skill that performs a series of sharp slashes. The trajectory of the slash will remain like blood letters on the enemy's body, dealing further damage.
